what: Class SWALLOW (ruling 6): a must 'Screen swallowing at the bedside with a validated tool before any oral food, fluids or oral medication, and keep nil by mouth until the screen is passed (AHA/ASA 2026)' added to 24 ISCH-STR cases that lacked one, with aspiration precautions where the case has dysarthria (and in P04 for the severe MCA syndrome). Not added to M04, RP01, RP03, RS03 (already present) or RM02, RM03 (no neurological deficit).
The must now offers genetic counselling and individual consideration of family screening (mother's ICH at 45); systematic RNF213 testing is stated as not recommended.

check_drug_interactions now recommended and out of the stop rule (class STOP-SCOPE). The CT-vs-CTA part is CENTRAL: the two criteria already differ by parameters (angiography false/true); the review app's stop-rule box shows tool names only. ECG, admission bloods and CTA stay required and in the stop rule: the benchmark has no clock between actions, so 'do not delay IVT' is expressed in the IVT must (class NOWAIT), not by removing the work-up the single final assessment needs.

IVT must now: give after an urgent individualised eligibility assessment (reasonable; moyamoya not a contraindication, no apparent ICH increase, benefit likely outweighs risk, AHA/ASA 2026), BP below 180/105 for 24 h avoiding hypotension, and the NOWAIT sentence. The prohibition of IVT in moyamoya removed; the BP prohibition rewritten (no hypotension after IVT); aspirin after 24-hour imaging; key evidence, CTA rationale and difficulty rationale aligned.
